head: da9d917
working_tree: runs 'after' and 'after2' were built from an export of the uncommitted step-4 commit-1 tree on da9d917; runs 'after3', 'after4' and 'after5' from an export of the same tree with the W1 fix (followInventory in internal/tui/model.go and TestProgressPageFollowsTheInventory), GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false. The fixed export's internal/tui, internal/api, internal/errtext, tests/integration and dev files were identical to the working tree when reviewed (hashes below)
scope: Production p tui against the disposable mock socket (dev/tui-mock --dataset small --theme dark, run through tests/integration/tui-observe.py): the progress page after Create, Rename and Retry, O then Enter on the blocked operation, Back/Esc while the follow is slowed, and errors answered by the follow. mock.configure slowed operation.inspect (before) or operation.wait (after) by up to 5 s, one call per configure. The mock's operations complete at once, so no operation was ever running: a wait answering running, the 20-second timeout, the phase follow during a wait and the tick resuming a wait after an error were not reachable. No Incus, Git or real-daemon claim
before: export of HEAD da9d917 (runs 'before', 'before2', 'before3'): the progress page follows with operation.inspect, then polls it on every 3-second tick while the operation is not completed

runs.before: O, Enter on the blocked operation with inspect slowed, four ticks on the blocked page with inspect slowed, r with the follow slowed while resizing 120x35 -> 80x24 -> 48x16, completed at all three sizes, Back; s, y (Stop), R rename with the follow slowed and q during it; R rename with inspect answering retry/deadline at all three sizes; c, forge, retained/00, Enter with the follow slowed, entry into the mock terminal, Ctrl-B d
runs.before2: fresh mock: O, Enter on the blocked operation, operation.retry from an outside client, observe after one tick
runs.before3: fresh mock: c, forge, retained/00, Enter with the follow slowed, 48x16, Esc during the follow, observe after it answered
runs.after: the 'before' path on the change with operation.wait slowed instead; plus r after the retry/deadline error; a Create whose wait answered failed/runtime at all three sizes; a Create left with Esc during a slowed wait (48x16 frame during the wait)
runs.after2: fresh mock: O, Enter on the blocked operation, operation.retry from an outside client, observe after 4 s and 8 s, Back, O, Enter again
runs.after3: W1 fix, fresh mock at 120x35: O, Enter on the blocked operation, operation.retry from an outside client, observe after 4 s and 8 s; then Back, c, forge, retained/00, Enter with the wait slowed, an inventory refresh during the wait, entry into the mock terminal, Ctrl-B d
runs.after4: W1 fix, fresh mock at 80x24: O, Enter on the blocked operation, operation.retry from an outside client, observe after 4 s
runs.after5: W1 fix, fresh mock at 120x35: O, Enter on the blocked operation, one tick on it, r with the wait slowed, completed

calls_after: mock.inspect after run 'after': one operation.inspect on O/Enter and none while the blocked page stayed open; each change or Retry was followed by exactly one operation.wait {timeout: 20}; nothing was read after completion; the Create whose wait failed issued no session.inspect; the Create left with Esc issued no session.inspect or session.attach
matched_frames: the progress page text is identical before and after at 120x35, 80x24 and 48x16 for: opening (inspect in flight), blocked, following/waiting, completed and the retry/deadline error, apart from operation IDs and request keys
component_tests: go test -count=1 ./internal/tui/... ./tests/integration/cmd/tui-mock/... ./internal/errtext/... passed on both after trees. TestWaitThatEndsRunningWaitsAgainAndKeepsTheIntentToAttach covers a wait answering running; on the fixed tree TestProgressPageFollowsTheInventory covers the phase taken from the inventory during a wait, the tick waiting again after a wait error, and a blocked operation changed elsewhere being read again. No component test covers a wait answering blocked, failed or superseded
tui_tests: just tui-tests: 8 terminal, 9 observer and 12 mock tests OK on the reviewed tree (28 s) and on the fixed tree (23 s); operation.wait is in the mock driver's required methods
improvement: the page of a blocked operation no longer polls: before, 'Waiting for daemon… (Back leaves accepted work running)' appeared on every 3-second tick and r was ignored while the poll was in flight (before-0007); after, the page stays still and r is always accepted (after-0007)

findings.W1: resolved by the W1 fix (followInventory). Seen on the reviewed tree: the page of a blocked operation no longer followed a change made elsewhere; after another client retried it, the page still read 'blocked / rename', the reason sentence, the Diagnostic and 'r retry operation' 4 s and 8 s later (after2-0004, after2-0005), where before the next tick showed it completed (before2-0005). On the fixed tree the same outside Retry showed 'session.rename · completed / complete' and 'Operation completed. Back returns to sessions.' within one refresh at 120x35 (after3-0004, still so at 8 s in after3-0005) and 80x24 (after4-0004), with one operation.inspect. The blocked page stays still while nothing changes (after5-0004), and Retry and Create still complete (after5-0006; after3-0015 entry, after3-0017 detach)
findings.W2: open (pre-existing, now on screen longer, low): at 48x16 the waiting line is clipped to 'Waiting for daemon… (Back leaves accepted work …' (identical before-0013 and after-0012). After, it stays for the whole wait instead of flashing at each poll
findings.W3: open (pre-existing, low): an error answered by the follow (operation.wait now, operation.inspect before) shows its sentence, 'The daemon took too long to answer; try again.' or 'The runtime failed; check Incus and try again.', and drops the intent to enter a created session: the Create whose wait failed was not entered and the page stayed as it was a tick later (after-0056, after-0057; before-0033 for inspect). The only 'try again' the page offers is r, which retries the operation; on the mock's completed operation it answered 'Operation completed.' (after-0037). In the mock the change's reply is already completed, so the header read 'completed / complete' beside the error and the tick did not wait again, before and after; with a running operation the tick would start the wait again (by reading; not reachable in the mock)
findings.W4: open (pre-existing, low): while O/Enter's operation.inspect is in flight the page shows an empty header ' ·  /' and blank Key and Session lines (identical before-0004 and after-0004)
findings.O3: still open from operation-reasons (pre-existing layout): at 48x16 the page draws eight body rows, leaves five rows empty below the feedback line, and 'Leaving this screen does not cancel an accepted operation.' is below the fold (after-0012, after-0013)
findings.O4: still open from operation-reasons (pre-existing key hint): 'r retry operation' is offered for every status; r is ignored while a wait is in flight, so on the page of a running operation it is now never accepted

calls_fixed: mock.inspect after 'after3' and 'after5': on the blocked page the outside Retry was followed by exactly one operation.inspect and nothing after; a blocked page the inventory also reads blocked, and a completed page, issued no read; the inventory refresh during the create's wait issued none; Retry was still followed by one operation.wait {timeout: 20}
